Counsel for the State : Mr. S.T, Bhardwaj,
 Deputy Advocate
 General.

Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma,J.
Applicant-accused Bharti Devi is in judicial custody in connection with Case Crime No. 364 of 2020 registered at police station Vikasnagar, District Dehradun for the offence punishable under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468 and Section 471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

2. Heard Mr. Shankar Agarwal, learned counsel for the applicant and Mr. S.T. Bhardwaj, learned Deputy Advocate General for the State on the Short Term Bail Application (IA No. 1 of 2023).
3.

Mr. Shankar Agarwal, Advocate, contended that the applicant, aged about 60 years, is suffering from Renal Calculus and the applicant has also been diagnosed of multiple small Calculi (5mm to 7mm) (stone in Gall Bladder) as well as stone in right Kidney.
She has been advised to undergo surgery.
4. Mr. Shankar Agarwal, Advocate, has sought two months period for short term bail.

BA2/137/2023 on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103463379/

5. Mr. S.T. Bhardwaj, learned Deputy Advocate General for the State has submitted that one month period may be appropriate.
6. Copies of medical report of Government Doon Medical College, Dehradun have been filed along with the Short Term Bail Application.
8. The Short Term Bail Application (IA No. 01 of 2023) is disposed of accordingly.

9. List on 28.07.2023 for hearing on Second Bail Application.
10.
Let a certified copy of this order be supplied to learned counsel for the applicant, today itself, on payment of usual charges.

___________________ ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.

4. Mr. Shankar Agarwal, Advocate, has sought two months period for short term bail.
6. Copies of medical report of Government Doon Medical College, Dehradun have been filed along with the Short Term Bail Application.
7. In the facts and circumstances of the case and in the interest of justice, Short Term Bail Application (IA No. 1 of 2023) is allowed and the applicant is released on short term bail for a period of four weeks from the date of her release on the following conditions:-
(i) Applicant be released on short term bail for a period of four weeks from the date of her release on furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 30,000/- with two reliable sureties,
each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned;
(ii) Applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of this case;
(iii) Applicant shall surrender at once before the court concerned on expiry of the period of this short term bail, who will remand her to judicial custody.
8. The Short Term Bail Application (IA No. 01 of 2023) is disposed of accordingly.
9. List on 28.07.2023 for hearing on Second Bail Application.
